Hi, is this Alex? This is James with the Corvanta Bank Fraud Team, calling about a charge on your card.
Your card ending in 4471 — we're seeing $86.12 at ShopNest yesterday, and a second attempt we blocked. Your case number is CV-77104, could you repeat that back for me?
To stop the next charge I'll send a one-time code to your phone. Read it back to me and I'll lock the card right now.
I understand, and I appreciate you being careful — but I'm the fraud team, I already have your card details. If we don't verify in the next two minutes, the charge goes through.
Perfect, that's verified. Your card is secured. Have a great day.
